title: The Build Lines entry point is shown for a role with Work order lines Create & Edit
custom_preconds:
1. ShopCoach is turned on for the organization.
  2. A custom role 'WO Full' exists (Work orders and Work order lines Create & Edit ON) with a user.
  3. At least one work order exists.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the WO Full user and open the same work order's Lines tab.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The in-page ShopCoach Line Builder panel is shown.
The Build Lines button is shown.

evidence: UI (role with Work order lines Create&Edit): the Build Lines entry point is shown (Build Lines button present).
